data.name: Kassab
data.gender_notes: Kassab is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kasaba' meaning to prepare or cook. In Islamic history, Kassab is a title of respect for a head chef or a master cook. The name Kassab carries the meaning “Cook, chef” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kassab usually hope their child will grow to embody cook, chef and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the nourishment and sustenance that Allah (SWT) provides.
data.etymology: Kassab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Cook, chef.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kassab total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: قصاب
in_arabic.long_meaning: قصاب هو اسم يعود إلى الجذر العربي ق ص ب، الذي يعني القطع أو الشق، ويشير إلى الشخص الذي يقوم بقطع أو раздел اللحم، وله تاريخ ديني وثقافي غني في التقاليد الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: قصاب
in_urdu.meaning: جس کا کام گوشت کاٹنا ہو
in_urdu.long_meaning: قصاب کا نام عربی gốc ق ص ب سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب کاٹنا یا چھرا کرنا ہے، اور یہ نام اس شخص کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو گوشت کاٹنے یا اسے تقسیم کرنے کا کام کرتا ہے، اور اسلامی روایات میں اس کا ایک خاص مقام ہے

in_hindi.name: क़स्साब
in_hindi.long_meaning: क़स्साब नाम अरबी मूल ق ص ب से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ काटना या विभाजित करना है, और यह नाम उस व्यक्ति के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है जो मांस काटने या इसे विभाजित करने का काम करता है, और इस्लामी परंपराओं में इसका एक विशेष स्थान है

in_pashto.name: قصاب
in_pashto.meaning: د چې د غوښې پرې کولو کار کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: قصاب نوم د عربي ریښې ق ص ب څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د پرې کولو یا وېشلو معنا لري، او دا نوم هغه شخص ته کارول کیږي چې د غوښې پرې کولو یا وېشلو دنده ترسره کوي، او په اسلامي رواجونو کې یې ځانګړی ځای دی

historical_references.reference: The Ottoman governor of Tripoli, Kassab Pasha, was a significant figure in Libyan history. He ruled Tripoli from 1551 to 1556, and is known for his military conquests and establishment of a prosperous trade network in the region.

Another historical figure with the name Kassab was the renowned Ottoman admiral, Kassab Pasha, who served under Sultan Selim II. He is famous for his naval victories against the Venetian and Spanish fleets in the late 16th century.
